seq: You made it! Welcome to Yolk island!
It's been a while! Did you come for the cooking festival?
Yes, I've heard great things about the local chef. Comb, I think he's called?
Oh yes, he's a legend around here. He's very hard to impress.
You'll have to prepare something very special to win the contest!
I wasn't necessarily planning to take part in it, but...
You have to! I'm curious to see what you come up with.
I'll check it out when I get to town. Which way?
Wait, before you go there. Can I ask you a favour?
I've just arrived and you're asking me a favour?
The thing is, I'm trying to gather some seeds for a recipe but the local plants are a bit... aggressive.
They call them Groens, and they are carnivorous plants that eat much more than insects.
I guess they also love good food.
I know you can take care of them!
There's a few of them just over the hill above the beach.
They are the key ingredient in my grandma's recipe for an amazing sweet cream.
